framework_integration.K0: versioned concept and regime identities can mutate only through explicit receipts
framework_integration.K1: ConceptState and RelationalAbstraction become typed knowledge objects
framework_integration.K2: discovered alignments, invariants, equivalence candidates and forbidden transfers
framework_integration.K3: native domain ownership remains external to generic transfer logic
framework_integration.K4: future self-model can estimate value of transfer search and conceptual revision
framework_integration.K5: anomalies can trigger search but never self-authorize revision
framework_integration.K6: donor saturation supplies a broad search space rather than a curated lesson list
framework_integration.absorptive_theory: regime maps/invariants/equivalences remain candidate structures until protected evidence
framework_integration.knowledge_metabolism: discovered abstractions enter recombination only after source/native checks; failed transfers become failure lessons

kill_conditions: fixed lessons equal or outperform discovery at lower cost
old valid cases are not retained after conceptual revision
conceptual changes have no hidden decision/prediction/formal residual
next_evidence: TD30 fresh generated conceptual-development confirmatory study

paper_effect.P_A: transfer discovery is a stricter successor mechanism question beyond donor retrieval
paper_effect.P_B: concept transition and representation equivalence can become relation-level tests
paper_effect.P_C: regime-selective activation becomes a discoverable hypothesis rather than a fixed rule
paper_effect.P_D: representation equivalence vs substantive independence can inform false corroboration tests
paper_effect.flagship: conceptual development becomes a candidate scientific-intelligence transition type, not an established field claim
